K(θ) = cos θ / ( r (R + r cos θ) )

The one-line miracle: the area element is dA = r(R + r cos θ) dθ dφ, so the r(R + r cos θ) cancels —

K dA = cos θ dθ dφ  ⟹  ∮∮ = ∫₀²π dφ ∫₀²π cos θ dθ = 2π · 0 = 0

— for every torus, any R, r. The split is +4π (outer half) and −4π (inner half) = 2πχ, with χtorus = 2 − 2g = 0 (Gauss–Bonnet, a closed surface).
